name: Sou Hei: Zhuo Yoru Hen ~Yami ni Moyuru Taiyou~
original_name: 双黑·灼夜篇~闇に燃ゆる太陽～
source:
This is the story of how you and Kuroba Natsu first meet, get to know each other, fall in love, and then have to go your separate ways due to unforeseen circumstances.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01411736.html/]DLsite[/url]]
